title: Red Happy, Ernest Rogers and the young players
summary: The interviewers ask about Red Happy and Ernest Rogers, and Williams says Rogers never played with the outstanding bands.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Do you remember Red Happy was supposed to be with Oliver sometime? Red Happy. Did you know?
Was he and I do? Red Happy, yeah. Red Happy played with O'Rell Wilde, with King Oliver, I remember Wilde.
What about Ernest Rogers? Was he playing?
Ernest Rogers was playing, but not with known bands, you know. He never was a big with none of the outstanding bands.

Yeah, he never became a singer. That's right, that's right, that's right. He was pretty young in those days, too, I guess. Yes, I guess, you know, Ernest was older than me, I think. In fact, all the fellas were young, we think of them as being older then, because in later years.
That's right, he started playing young. That's right. That's right. That's right.
